# Logistel - B2B Multi-Tenant Logistics & Freight Dispatch Platform

> Logistel is a high-performance B2B logistics infrastructure platform operating in Nigeria. It connects logistics providers, dispatchers, drivers, and customers through automated dynamic pricing, real-time GPS tracking, automated Paystack payment settlement, and multi-tenant fleet management.

## Key Features
- **Dynamic Pricing Engine**: Automated fare quotes calculated via Haversine distance, vehicle type multipliers (Bike, Car, Van, Truck), and tenant base rates.
- **Live Courier & Freight Tracking**: Turn-by-turn navigation, Leaflet/OSRM maps, and sub-second WebSocket telemetry updates.
- **Unique Payment Reference (UPR)**: Instant payment reconciliation with Paystack card, bank transfer, and USSD checkouts.
- **Multi-Tenant Fleet Operations**: Dedicated company subdomains (e.g. `yourcompany.logistel.com.ng`), driver onboarding, and role-based access control.
